entries.title: Garden walk
entries.bodyText: Morning walk through the garden. Morning walk through the garden. Morning walk through the garden. Morning walk through the garden. The rain started 🌧️ near the old bridge and we sheltered under the oak. Later the sun returned. Later the sun returned. Later the sun returned.

entries.bodyText: Über die Brücke, then café au lait. Garden later?
